title: Clinic
description: Contract for one clinic demo. Group A (block-level) is constant across a specialty block — set once in blocks.json/tokens.json and referenced here. Group B (clinic-level) is populated per clinic. Every Group B field's provenance is tracked in data_status as web | client | missing (plus draft, for model-generated copy awaiting operator review, Phase 6b only). Fields marked x-build-blocking render a visible DATA NEEDED placeholder when missing — never a guess.
$comment: display_name is build-blocking but deliberately NOT schema-required: a clinic record must be storable before its data arrives (rule 1 degrades missing build-blocking fields to visible placeholders, which requires the record to exist).

block_id.$comment: GROUP A — block-level. Values constant per specialty block.

specialty.$comment: Group A. Human-readable specialty, e.g. 'Dermatology & Aesthetics'.

schema_org_type.$comment: Group A. JSON-LD @type used in Phase 6b.

section_order.$comment: Group A. Normally inherited from blocks.json; a clinic-level override requires operator approval (rule 4).

palette_ref.$comment: Group A. Key into tokens.json, e.g. 'derm-aesthetic' or 'derm-aesthetic.variant'.

allowed_content.$comment: Group A. Block-level intent flags. Rendering additionally requires the same flag to be explicitly true in compliance.json (rule 3) — BOTH gates must pass.

slug.$comment: GROUP B from here down — clinic-level, populated per clinic.

demo_token.$comment: Random, unguessable, never reused (rule 7). Demo URL = /demo/<block_id>/<slug>-<demo_token>/. Routing datum, not clinic data — generated by the pipeline.

prospect_status.$comment: Sales-funnel state, shown on HQ pages only. 'signed' clinics graduate to their dedicated go-live repo.

services.$comment: The real differentiator. Never padded with generic specialty services the clinic didn't state.

fees.$comment: Optional; only what the clinic explicitly consents to publish (intake Q12).

phone_e164.$comment: Build-blocking is satisfied by phone_e164 OR whatsapp OR email — at least one contact method (see x-build-blocking-note). If a supplied number does not parse cleanly to E.164, flag it in DATA-NEEDED — never invent digits.

rating.$comment: Rule 2: always a dated snapshot with source. Never from memory. (review_count lives here as 'count'.)

reviews.$comment: Rule 2: every entry must also have a row in /intake/reviews-compliance-log.md. Renders only if compliance gate passes AND compliance_checked is true.

usp.$comment: One line from the clinic (intake Q13) — never composed by the model.

data_status.$comment: One entry per Group B field above (keyed by field name). 'draft' is legal only for meta_title/meta_description (Phase 6b generated copy awaiting review). This object drives DATA-NEEDED.md and the QA pass.
data_status.x-build-blocking-note: Build-blocking set: display_name, address_full, services, and at least ONE of {phone_e164, whatsapp, email}. Everything else degrades gracefully to a placeholder or an omitted section.

sources.$comment: For every field with data_status 'web': the source URL it was pulled from (rule 1).
